release.notes: BETA RELEASE — Build 15.10.5.2 (v1.0.5.9): Premium black-and-gold Score Studio with score-sound volume, custom MP3/WAV/OGG jingle import and preview, and editable messages by score bracket. Corrected 3-2-1 countdown position so it no longer covers lyrics; early lyrics remain a non-highlighted preview until their actual MIDI timing markers. OTA update checks now request a fresh manifest to avoid stale CDN responses. Preserves karaoke library/queue, MIDI-timed lyric highlighting, playback, and scoring calculations. Stable channel unchanged.
